summary: Final pre-publish frontend validation across Admin, Counsellor (Priya) and Reception. All 9 requested feature areas verified end-to-end on the preview URL. Admin Settings shows the new Razorpay Key ID + Secret card and no Offer/Registration/Discount section remains; save works. Users page lists Anjali counsellor and Edit dialog exposes name/role/phone; Courses Edit dialog exposes name/fee/duration and saves. Lead detail Edit Details dialog opens with all requested fields (name, phone, email, city, qualification, batch, join timeline, counsellor, remarks) — editing name persists and the header updates immediately (revert also verified). Counsellor WhatsApp dialog now includes Payment amount select (₹500/₹1000) and Link validity select (Valid/Today only/24 hours); clicking 'Create Link & Open WhatsApp' successfully creates a Razorpay MOCK payment link (payment appears on the lead's payment section) and triggers a wa.me popup, followed by a success toast. Bulk upload dialog has an Assign-to select listing Auto + all 3 counsellors incl. Anjali; uploaded a 2-row CSV assigned to Anjali and the API returned 'Imported 2 · Skipped 0'. Visited page status filter is present with all new statuses (New, Contacted, Visited, Interested, Possible Joining, Future Joining, Registered, Lost) and narrows the list correctly. All dashboard headings/buttons are in English — no Devanagari, no Hinglish tokens detected. Reception Student Registration form has been rebranded (Arts of Finance panel + hero + logo), does NOT contain any Assigned Counsellor field, exposes 'When do they want to join?' (visit-form-join-select), and successfully submits a lead with name+phone+course+consent (auto-assigned to a counsellor, success page shown).

design_issues.screen: Edit Lead / Add Update / WhatsApp dialogs
issues: Radix a11y warning persists on a few DialogContent nodes (edit-lead-dialog and lead-detail WhatsApp/Note/Followup dialogs) — 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'. Cosmetic; does not block flows.

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription to LeadDetail WhatsApp/Note/Schedule dialogs and edit-lead-dialog to silence remaining Radix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: FollowupDashboard.jsx is now ~453 lines and holds 5 dialogs (add-update, WhatsApp, manual add, bulk upload, today's plan) — recommend splitting each dialog into its own file for maintainability before further growth.

sendWa in FollowupDashboard.jsx silently swallows payment-link errors into the outer catch, so a Razorpay 4xx would still open WhatsApp with a stale preview body (no payment link substitution). Consider aborting on payment failure or explicitly toasting the payment error.

VisitForm.jsx success screen still says 'Assigned Counsellor' + counsellor name — that is fine because the input field was removed, but confirm this is intentional (reception can still see who the lead was auto-routed to).

Settings.jsx sends razorpay_key_id/secret even when unchanged; consider only sending edited fields to avoid overwriting server secrets with masked/blank values (password input value=s.razorpay_key_secret starts blank from GET if backend does not echo, which could nuke a stored key on save).
seed_data_creation: Renamed a lead via edit dialog and reverted. Created 2 TEST_Bulk* leads via bulk upload assigned to Anjali. Created 1 TEST_Reception User lead via reception visit form. Created a ₹500/24hrs Razorpay MOCK payment link on the first lead of Priya's dashboard.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase-C features validated on preview URL. Seed drift: a few TEST_* leads and one mock payment link added to Priya's pipeline. Razorpay keys remain blank (MockProvider active by design). No blocking issues; only the Radix DialogDescription a11y warnings remain as cosmetic cleanup.
